motivation.age_stage_a_r2: Run 36703139110 had 16/16 T=64 but four instrumentation holds, all caused only by frl_refill_stock kprobe misses.
motivation.requirement: Owner refill detection cannot be removed because refill_stock can change per-CPU stock without an immediate owner page_counter_uncharge.
motivation.proposal: Use a tracefs histogram trigger in soft-disabled mode to aggregate owner refill sizes without writing every matching refill event to the trace ring.

design.target: fresh verified b63-capable worker, no post-VERIFY target touches during pilot window

LOG.description: owner-memcg refill_stock event enabled and written to trace ring

HIST.description: refill event logging disabled; hist trigger soft-enables event and aggregates by nr_pages

acceptance: HIST mode successfully records owner refill hitcount with event logging disabled
at least one HIST identity observes owner refill activity
HIST refill kprobe miss rate is no worse than LOG and preferably zero across all four HIST identities
no scientific Age claim is made from this pilot
next_if_pass: Use count-only owner refill histogram in the CPU-local memcg stock-slot pressure experiment, while preserving ordinary Q64 and owner-uncharge receipts.

authority.authorization_basis: user explicitly requested continued research on 2026-09-30
